notes: Independently read all 17 eligible production source files (including browser.d.ts), package.json and openclaw.plugin.json at d912f0c06e7af29a4a40c4211bec0bb76d473f10. Reviewed source and metadata plus 15 individually excluded files partition every file under extensions/mcp-relay.

No production local import escapes the plugin root. package.json identifies index.ts and src/control-ui.ts as entries; its build scripts invoke host tooling, but do not establish additional plugin-owned/shared shipped JS/TS source. Manifest dist assets are generated output paths, not files present in this source tree. SDK implementation files and separately installed dependencies were not recursively audited.

Public package exports and SDK facades prove the exact 11 SDK module specifiers and original exported names. No local SDK barrel or reexport sites occur. Directly destructured dynamic SDK imports resolve named exports without an un-narrowed namespace dependency.

definePluginEntry supplies the OpenClawPluginApi registration parameter. Typed gateway-method helpers preserve that API provenance. api.runtime passed to RelayState resolves to runtime.state.openKeyedStoreV2; no runtime root or api.runtime prefix is emitted. Built-in Pick<PluginRuntime, "state"> supplies the separate runtime.state type dependency.

The config callback in ServiceOptions is a plugin-owned forwarding wrapper around api.runtime.config.current(). Reads of returned configuration snapshots do not extend runtime paths. Gateway request/ingress bindings, scheduler contexts, returned keyed stores, and ControlUiHost are separate SDK contracts, not OpenClawPluginApi/PluginRuntime handles. Their imported type dependencies remain recorded.

createOperations receives api.logger unchanged from its sole production caller, so its logger.error call has proven api.logger.error provenance. API configuration access stops at basePath: OpenClawPluginApi.config is OpenClawConfig (src/plugins/plugin-api.types.ts:216), whose gateway uses GatewayConfig (src/config/types.openclaw.ts:75); GatewayControlUiConfig inherits the schema input (src/config/types.gateway.ts:36-40), and basePath is z.string().optional() (src/config/zod-schema.gateway.ts:205). Built-in String trim/replace are not SDK members, so this finding is member-access.

GatewayControlUiIngressError is imported as a value and used in an explicit type predicate, making its export mixed; instanceof uses do not invent constructor calls. WebSocket construction and defaultRuntime member calls contribute call kinds to their imported exported-root identities.

Only cliCommands.name is an agreed manifest contract here. Activation commands, category, enabledByDefault, configSchema, uiHints and Control UI artifact metadata are not extra contract identities. No named API hooks are registered.

The browser.d.ts declaration contains only a CSS module declaration; ui-tunnel-body.ts has only plugin-local imports and platform APIs. Both were reviewed and have zero findings. No genuine unresolved SDK/API/runtime references remain.

Source-only reconciliation: parseMcpRelayConfig receives api.pluginConfig unchanged from index.ts:33 and :50. Its raw: unknown parameter, undefined fallback at config.ts:12, and object/field guards preserve origin on the original-object branch; config.ts:19 and :37 therefore contribute api.pluginConfig.relayUrl and api.pluginConfig.agentId as runtime member-access dependencies. This records possible source dependencies without claiming execution. runtime.version remains runtime/member-access: its unchanged value flows through gateway.version into truncateText, but text.length is built-in String behavior and does not create runtime.version.length or a call kind. agentId.trim likewise does not extend the SDK path.
